exempt.name: every order of a Save, its answer, another place, loads, Discard and typing
exempt.reason: Every-order test: its invariants throw in the model's check, outside the named test, so the runner would call a break INVALID (as for bot-edit-sequences in pr-119). The PR records six hand breaks of skill-edit-state.ts, each caught (tmp record seq-hand-breaks.txt): Discard while a Save waits, the base following an older answer, Save on in a conflict, a Save on its way not counted, leave ignoring it, Discard moving the base down. Invariant 1 has no break of its own (Not claimed).
